name: Get 10 Plus
author: Addicting Games
description: Get 10 Plus is a free math game. Math is educational, math is fun, and now math is a game. Perhaps you have wondered exactly how many different ways there are to add up basic numbers to get to ten. Perhaps you think you're really good at adding up basic numbers to get to ten. Maybe you don't think it's hard, but we are here to tell you it is actually quite challenging and often in some cases it is also fun. Math puzzles are fun and educational. They also improve your mental math abilities which can be handy in everyday life. Have fun with these math puzzles. They are designed to be difficult, but fun. Now, math games are a great way to learn math by yourself. There are no tricks or gimmicks. For those of you who like numbers and patterns, this should be a piece of cake. And for those of you who don't like numbers and patterns, this could be a nightmare. The coolest thing about this game is the number ten. That is right, the number ten. See, check it out, you can do a lot with the number ten: it's the only number that works in a multiplication problem and in a division problem, and you can use the same number for addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division. Crazy weird facts for a fun math game.
